newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Brown says will review jobless data.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Brown says will review jobless data.

text.p: If the opposition Labour Party wins the May election, it will launch a review of how Britain gauges the level of unemployment, finance spokesman Gordon Brown said on Wednesday.
"Of course we will review the figures," Brown said at a Labour Party press conference.
His remarks follow newspaper reports that the government privately admits the current unemployment data understate the level of joblessness.
UK March unemployment data are due at 0830 GMT and are expected to show the thirteenth successive monthly decline.
